query: SELECT id, COALESCE(required_role, '') AS "required_role!", size FROM central.artifacts WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND task_id = $2 AND run_id = $3 AND state = 'ready' AND delete_intent_at IS NULL ORDER BY CASE required_role WHEN 'harness.report' THEN 0 WHEN 'harness.patch' THEN 1 WHEN 'harness.commits' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, created_at, id LIMIT $4
